description: This file defines the UriComparator class, which provides static methods to determine if a modified URL is cross-origin compared to an original URL, based on host, scheme, and port comparisons.

classes.name: UriComparator
classes.description: Provides static methods to compare URIs for cross-origin status within the GuzzleHttp Psr7 implementation.

methods.name: isCrossOrigin
methods.description: Determines if a modified URL should be considered cross-origin with respect to an original URL.

methods.name: computePort
methods.description: Computes the port number for a given URI, defaulting to 80 or 443 based on the scheme if not explicitly specified.
